items.note: Done — it's live now. On a client's Tasks tab the completed ones have moved into their own "Completed (N)" section at the bottom, closed by default. One click on the heading opens it, and it stays open for that client while you're working, so you're not re-opening it every time you come back. It's collapsed rather than hidden on purpose: the count is always on the heading, so if something got ticked by mistake you can still open it and untick it. The open list at the top now only shows what's actually outstanding, and the counter next to "Tasks" counts those. Thanks Karla — this was a good catch on a client we've been running a while.
